question: Prometheus has introduced a new AppenderV2 interface in storage/interface_append.go that replaces the old storage.Appender interface. Which files across Thanos, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib would need to migrate their custom Appender implementations, wrappers, or consumers to the new AppenderV2 interface?

thanos.reason: Defines receiveAppender and writer structs that implement/consume storage.Appender for appending samples, histograms, and exemplars from Prometheus remote write requests into multi-tenant TSDB storage. Contains Append, AppendHistogram methods that map to V1 Appender.
Implements receiveAppender class for Cap'n Proto decoded Prometheus remote write payloads, using V1 Appender methods (Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar) to write into TSDB.
Multi-tenant TSDB manager that exposes an Appender() method and tenantAppendable interface, providing storage.Appender instances per tenant for the receive path.
Test utility that calls Appender() on Prometheus TSDB instances and uses V1 Append/AppendHistogram methods to populate test blocks with samples.
Test utility with appendHistogramSamples, appendFloatHistogramSamples, appendFloatSamples functions that use V1 Appender interface to create test TSDB heads.

AggrChunk implements chunkenc.Chunk interface including Appender() method; while this is a chunk-level appender (not storage.Appender), it interacts with the storage append surface and may need alignment.
Test file using nopAppendable that implements storage.Appendable returning a no-op Appender, needs migration to AppendableV2/AppenderV2.

mimir.reason: Implements storage.Appender interface (MimirAppender class) with Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, Commit, Rollback methods to convert OTLP metrics into Mimir's PreallocTimeseries format. Provides contractsProvided: storage.appender.

Defines pusherAppender and noopAppender classes implementing storage.Appender with Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, SetOptions, AppendSTZeroSample, AppendHistogramSTZeroSample methods. Also defines pusherAppendable and noopAppendable implementing storage.Appendable.
Per-tenant TSDB wrapper that provides Appender() method returning storage.Appender, with acquireAppendLock/releaseAppendLock. ContractsProvided includes storage.appender.
Processes soft append errors from V1 Appender operations (storage.ErrTooOldSample, storage.ErrOutOfBounds, etc.). Error handling logic would need to align with AppenderV2's AppendPartialError model.
Core ingester service that calls Appender() on per-tenant TSDBs during Push operations, consuming the V1 Appender interface for sample ingestion.
TSDBBuilder that creates per-tenant TSDBs and uses Appender for ingesting Prometheus samples and histograms during block building.
OTLP HTTP handler that creates appenders via the otlpappender package for converting and ingesting OTLP metrics through the V1 Appender interface.
Backfill utility that creates TSDB blocks from series sets, using storage append operations for data migration.

loki.reason: Implements pusherAppender class with V1 Appender methods (Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, SetOptions, AppendSTZeroSample, AppendCTZeroSample, AppendHistogramSTZeroSample, AppendHistogramCTZeroSample) and pusherAppendable implementing storage.Appendable. Core ruler-to-Loki adapter.

Implements both storage.Appender and storage.AppenderV2 interfaces (appender and appenderV2Adapter classes) for WAL-based metric storage. Already has partial V2 awareness via appenderV2Adapter but still implements V1 Appender methods. ContractsProvided includes both storage.appender and storage.appenderv2.
WAL registry that provides Appender() method and defines discardingAppender and notReadyAppender classes implementing storage.Appender for edge cases (not-ready, discarding).
Per-tenant WAL storage instance with Appender() method returning storage.Appender for ruler metric ingestion. Integration surface includes storage:storage.appender.
WAL replay utilities with Append, AppendHistograms, AppendFloatHistograms, AppendExemplars functions that use V1 Appender patterns for WAL data recovery.

tempo.reason: Defines noopAppender and capturingAppender test implementations of storage.Appender with V1 methods (Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, SetOptions, Commit, Rollback). Used across all registry tests.
Gauge metric collectMetrics method uses storage.Appender to append gauge samples via V1 Append method.
Histogram metric collectMetrics method uses storage.Appender for appending histogram bucket/count/sum samples and exemplars via V1 Append and AppendExemplar methods.
Counter metric collectMetrics method uses storage.Appender to append counter samples via V1 Append method.
Native histogram collectMetrics method uses storage.Appender for appending native Prometheus histograms via V1 AppendHistogram method.
Storage implementation with Appender() method that provides storage.Appender instances backed by WAL for the metrics generator pipeline.

opentelemetry-collector-contrib.reason: Implements storage.Appender interface (transaction class) with Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, SetOptions, Commit, Rollback methods. Converts scraped Prometheus metrics to OpenTelemetry pmetric.Metrics format. Core Prometheus-to-OTLP bridge.
Implements storage.Appendable interface that creates transaction-based Appender instances for the Prometheus receiver. Returns V1 Appender from Appender() method.

answer.summary: The AppenderV2 migration impacts 28 files across 5 repos. The heaviest impact is on Mimir (8 files) and Thanos (7 files) which have deep storage.Appender integrations for multi-tenant ingestion. Loki (5 files) already shows partial V2 awareness in its WAL layer via appenderV2Adapter. Tempo (6 files) uses Appender in its metrics generator registry. OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib (2 files) has a clean Appender implementation in its Prometheus receiver that serves as the Prometheus-to-OTLP bridge. Key migration patterns: (1) Replace Append/AppendHistogram/AppendExemplar/UpdateMetadata with unified AppendV2 method, (2) Replace Appendable with AppendableV2, (3) Adopt AppenderTransaction for commit/rollback, (4) Handle AppendPartialError instead of per-method error returns, (5) Use LimitedAppenderV1 shim during transition.
